clean.pptx.description: A well-formed single-slide deck. Title box, body text in high contrast, one image with alt text. Used to verify checks do not produce false positives.

overlapping_objects.pptx.description: Two rectangles (Red Box, Blue Box) overlap between x=3.5" and x=5.0".

object_off_slide.pptx.description: Off-Slide Shape starts at x=11", outside the 10"-wide slide boundary.

text_overflow.pptx.description: Text box with auto_size=NONE and dimensions 3"×1.2" contains ~250 words — far more than the box can display.

small_text.pptx.description: Body run set to 8pt — below any recommended reading size.

low_contrast.pptx.description: Body text color #BBBBBB on white (#FFFFFF) slide background. Measured contrast ratio ≈ 1.86:1; WCAG 2.2 AA requires 4.5:1.

missing_alt_text.pptx.description: Picture shape 'Chart Image' has no descr attribute on its cNvPr element.

no_title.pptx.description: Single slide with only a body text box — no title element anywhere.

reading_order.pptx.description: Three labeled boxes added to XML in the order Step3→Step1→Step2, but their visual positions are top-to-bottom Step1→Step2→Step3.

crowded.pptx.description: Title box plus 12 data-item text boxes — 13 shapes on one slide.
